definitions.explanation: Something beyond ordinary human understanding that inspires awe or wonder. Refers to the mysterious quality of nature, the divine, or the universe. Often used with {的|てき} to form the na-adjective {神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神秘|しんぴ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧。
examples.english: To touch upon the mystery of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深海|しんかい}→深海：16050_shinkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき}な⟦{生|い}き{物|もの}→生き物：01783_ikimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are many mysterious creatures in the deep sea.

examples.japanese: オーロラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき}な{美|うつく}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: I was left speechless by the mystical beauty of the aurora.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the form {神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき} (mystical, mysterious) as a na-adjective. Carries a positive, awe-inspiring connotation unlike ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧ (strange, puzzling) or ⟦{謎|なぞ}→謎：03505_nazo⟧ (riddle, enigma).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神秘|しんぴ}{的|てき}な: mystical, mysterious
- {神秘|しんぴ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be wrapped in mystery
- ⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神秘|しんぴ}: the mystery of life
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神秘|しんぴ}: the mystery of nature
- {神秘|しんぴ}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: mystical experience
